sources.cite: Microsoft Learn, 'Use Azure Firewall to protect Azure Virtual Desktop deployments'
sources.note: Read through a summarizing fetch on 2026-11-17. Quoted: 'Azure Firewall uses the Azure Virtual Desktop FQDN tag WindowsVirtualDesktop'; rules are needed for each required FQDN and endpoint; 'Don't use TLS inspection with Azure Virtual Desktop'; to avoid disconnections when all traffic goes through the firewall, a route with destination type Service tag, destination WindowsVirtualDesktop and next hop Internet gives direct access to the gateway and broker.
